title: Cute design, but pretty useless as a rug
text: Cute design, but pretty useless as a rug. What a waste of money.  These rugs attract cat hair like magic, and it's impossible to remove it from the type of fabric.  Also, the rugs have some type of backing on them, but they do not adhere to my hardwood floors.  Using them as food bowl pads right now instead of their original intended purpose as kitchen rugs.
